summary: Chose to keep CLAUDE.md gate authority over reporter's prompt-injection-only alternative for issue #9
context: Wrote design spec for plugin hygiene fixes (issues #8, #9, #10) at docs/superpowers/specs/. Issue #7 (decision/scope GC) deferred to separate Spec B.
rationale: CLAUDE.md persists in system context every turn and survives compaction, while prompt-injected SessionStart content gets summarized away. Empirical evidence from prior testing showed Claude was finicky about calling twining_record without CLAUDE.md anchor. No new data shows that has changed; risk-asymmetric move is to keep authority. Filed follow-up to benchmark this on current models.
assumptions: #8 root cause is on our side (prompt-type hook config) not waiting for upstream Claude Code fix
Plugin and MCP server bumps will be coordinated minor releases (1.9.0 plugin, 1.19.0 server)
Bash hook scripts will get a uniform 2-line TWINING_DISABLED guard — exit 0 with no JSON is treated as allow/no-op by Claude Code
